attchmntText: Viyash Scientific Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Viyash Scientific Limited filed an investor presentation for Q2 FY27 results on November 13, 2026. The company reported H1 FY27 revenue of 19,343 million rupees, up 17.8% year-on-year. H1 profit after tax was 164 crore rupees, up approximately 50% from the previous year. Adjusted profit after tax with normalized ESOP cost was 204 crore rupees. Q2 FY27 revenue was 9,879 million rupees, a 16.2% increase year-on-year. EBITDA for the half-year was 4,124 million rupees, up 29.9%. Net debt decreased to 261 million rupees from 4,095 million rupees in H1 FY26. The acquisition of BioForLife in Italy was completed on October 1, 2026. The company is investing in new oncology capabilities and a companion animal manufacturing facility.

attchmntText: Viyash Scientific Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release for Q2 FY27".
voiceSummary: Viyash Scientific Limited announced financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. H1 FY27 revenue increased 17.8% to 19,343 million rupees. H1 profit after tax rose 49% to 1,639 million rupees. Q2 FY27 revenue was 9,879 million rupees, up 16.2% year on year. Q2 profit after tax was 847 million rupees, up 16.1% year on year. EBITDA before ESOP costs for H1 was 4,124 million rupees. Net debt to EBITDA ratio is 0.0x. The company completed the acquisition of BioForLife in Italy. An earnings call is scheduled for November 14, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST.

attchmntText: Viyash Scientific Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Viyash Scientific Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board also approved the Independent Auditor’s Limited Review Report. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 3,906.50 million, compared to 3,397.50 million in the corresponding previous period. Profit after tax for the quarter was 233.60 million, versus 228.40 million previously. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue was 7,443.40 million, and profit after tax was 442.80 million. Earnings per share for the quarter were 0.53 basic and 0.52 diluted. The trading window for dealing in the Company’s securities remains closed until 48 hours from this announcement.
